title: fix(app-shell): the icon-mode sidebar rail scrolls vertically when its rows overflow (objectui#12794)
body:
Fixes #12794
Clause-②: no

## What changed

In the collapsed (icon-mode) console sidebar the rail now scrolls vertically when its rows overflow, as the expanded sidebar does. Before, the rows below the fold could not be reached until the sidebar was expanded again.

The `SidebarContent` primitive clips the rail with `group-data-[state=collapsed]:group-data-[collapsible=icon]:overflow-hidden`. `UnifiedSidebar` now passes one class constant, `ICON_RAIL_SCROLLS_VERTICALLY`, which sits beside the objectui#12744 constant and uses the same icon-mode variant:

- `overflow-auto`: tailwind-merge (`cn`) drops the primitive's same-variant `overflow-hidden` only for a later same-variant `overflow-*` shorthand. Measured: with only `overflow-y-auto` / `overflow-x-hidden`, both the primitive's `overflow-hidden` and the longhands survive the merge, and stylesheet order decides the result. So the shorthand is the pin.
- `overflow-x-hidden`: the horizontal axis stays clipped (the rail's content is 109px wide in a 47px rail) and the rail never scrolls sideways.
- `[scrollbar-width:none]!`: the rail draws no scrollbar. With the console's thin bar visible, the rail's clientWidth drops from 47 to 37, the 32px buttons run under the bar, and the icons sit 5.5px off the scroll box's centre. The class is important because the console themes every scrollbar with an unlayered `*` rule, which outranks layered utilities. The wheel, touch and keyboard focus still scroll the rail.

Off icon mode nothing changes: the expanded sidebar and the mobile sheet keep the primitive's `overflow-auto` and the host's scrollbar. `packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` (Shadcn-synced) is untouched. No export, prop, type member or i18n key moves.

## Live readings

Chromium at 1280 x 800, objectstack `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --fresh`), console Vite from this worktree. Icon mode with every group opened, collapsed with Ctrl+B, starting at scrollTop 0. Visible-scrollbar readings run without Playwright's default `--hide-scrollbars`.

| reading | main `4839f5c` | this branch `b1c05f1` |
|---|---|---|
| rows present | 49 | 49 |
| rows below the fold at scrollTop 0 | 29 | 29 |
| scrollTop after one wheel (delta 400) over the rail | 0 | 400 |
| scrollTop after wheeling to the end | 0 | 1165 (scrollHeight 1917 minus clientHeight 752) |
| last row (Renewals Pipeline) inside the rail and hit-testable | no (top 1909, rail bottom 800) | yes (744 to 776) |
| click on the last row navigates | no | yes |
| computed overflow-x / overflow-y | hidden / hidden | hidden / auto |
| scrollLeft after a sideways wheel | 0 | 0 |
| rail offsetWidth / clientWidth | 47 / 47 | 47 / 47 |
| first icon centre vs the scroll box | +0.5px | +0.5px |
| rejected option, thin bar kept: offsetWidth / clientWidth, icon offset | n/a | 47 / 37, +5.5px |
| CONTROL expanded: offsetWidth / clientWidth, overflow, scrollbar-width | 255 / 245, auto / auto, thin | 255 / 245, auto / auto, thin |
| CONTROL mobile sheet (390 x 844): overflow, scrollbar-width | auto / auto, thin | auto / auto, thin |

## Tests (at `b1c05f1`)

- New `UnifiedSidebar.iconRailScroll-12794.test.tsx` mounts the real `UnifiedSidebar` with the real `SidebarProvider` / `Sidebar` / `SidebarContent`, using the harness of the objectui#12744 test. It derives the icon-mode prefix from the bare primitive's own `:overflow-hidden` token. Collapsed: the content has the variant's `overflow-auto`, `overflow-x-hidden` and `[scrollbar-width:none]!`, and no icon-mode `overflow-hidden`, `overflow-y-hidden` or clip survives. CONTROL, expanded: every class outside the variant equals the bare primitive's list with the old `pt-2`.
- Ablation, each leg restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty: (A) call site back to `pt-2` turns the collapsed test red; (B) shorthand swapped for `overflow-y-auto` turns it red, which is the merge trap above; (C) an unconditional `overflow-x-hidden` turns both tests red.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` in full, as `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --shard=K/8` for K = 1..8: 1512 of 1512 files, 1511 passed and 1 skipped; 14120 tests passed, 9 skipped, 0 failed. A single unsharded run cannot finish inside the container's command limits.
- `type-check`, `build` and eslint on the touched files for `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0 (lint warnings all predate this diff). `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:new-line-citations`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/layout` `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` also renders `Sidebar collapsible="icon"` with a bare `SidebarContent`, and `AppShell` forwards `defaultOpen`. Read from source only and not measured: a published `AppSchemaRenderer` collapsed to icons may clip its rail the same way. The dispatch ruled the `packages/layout` sidebars out of scope, so this PR does not touch them. No carrier.
- objectui#12795 (the keyboard half of the icon-mode family) remains open and is not addressed here.
